summary: Monday's close showed a defensive tilt taking hold: tech-heavy QQQ lagged sharply behind consumer staples and long Treasuries kept rallying, while crypto extended its slide as bitcoin and ether both fell further. Elevated volatility across stocks and gold suggests hedging demand stayed in place even as headline sentiment held neutral.
tweet: Oct 19 close: growth stocks lagged staples and bonds as crypto kept sliding and volatility stayed elevated — risk-off under a neutral headline score.
